description_en: Retrieves a list of audio and video information
kebab_example: aliyun vod get-video-list --cate-id 781111 --status Uploading,Normal --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --sort-by CreationTime:Asc --start-time 2017-01-11T12:00:00Z --end-time 2017-01-11T12:59:00Z --storage-location out-0000.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com --reference-ids 123-123,1234-1234 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetVideoList

parameters.help_en:
The category ID. You can obtain the category ID by using the following methods:
Log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Configuration Management > Media Management Configuration > Category Management to view the category ID.
Obtain the value of CateId from the response when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/56401.html operation.
Obtain the value of CateId from the response when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/56406.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
分类ID。可通过以下方式获取：
登录点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择配置管理 > 媒资管理配置 > 分类管理查看分类ID。
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/56401.html接口创建分类时，分类ID为返回参数CateId的值。
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/56406.html接口查询分类时，为请求后返回参数CateId的值
parameters.name: cate_id

parameters.help_en:
The video status. You can specify multiple statuses. Separate multiple statuses with commas (,). Valid values:

Uploading: The video is being uploaded.
UploadFail: The video failed to be uploaded.
UploadSucc: The video has been uploaded.
Transcoding: The video is being transcoded.
TranscodeFail: The video failed to be transcoded.
Checking: The video is being reviewed.
Blocked: The video is blocked.
Normal: The video is in a normal state.
ProduceFail: The video failed to be produced.

For more information about video statuses and related limits, see [Status: video status](~~52839#section-p7c-jgy-070~~)
parameters.help_zh:
视频状态。支持获取多个状态的视频，多个状态之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：

Uploading：上传中。
UploadFail：上传失败。
UploadSucc：上传完成。
Transcoding：转码中。
TranscodeFail：转码失败。
Checking：审核中。
Blocked：屏蔽。
Normal：正常。
ProduceFail：合成失败。

各视频状态的具体含义解释及相关限制，请参见[Status：视频状态](~~52839#section-p7c-jgy-070~~)
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 列表页大小。默认值为10，最大值为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The sorting rule of the results. Valid values:

CreationTime:Desc (default): sorted by creation time in descending order.
CreationTime:Asc: sorted by creation time in ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
查询结果排序。取值：

CreationTime:Desc（默认值）：按创建时间倒序。
CreationTime:Asc：按创建时间升序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query based on CreationTime (creation time). Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: CreationTime（创建时间）的开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query based on CreationTime. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: CreationTime的结束时间，需晚于开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The storage address of the audio or video file
parameters.name: storage_location

parameters.help_en: The list of custom IDs. Specify one or more custom IDs separated by commas (,). A maximum of 20 IDs are supported
parameters.help_zh: 自定义 ID 列表。由一个或多个自定义 ID 组成，多个 ID 之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。最多支持 20 个
parameters.name: reference_ids

Total.description_en: The total number of audio and video files

Video.description_en: The list of audio and video information. A maximum of 5000 entries can be returned
Video.description_zh: 获取音/视频信息列表。最大支持获取前5000条

items.description_en: The details of the audio or video file

AppId.description_en: The application ID. Default value: app-1000000

CoverURL.description_en: The thumbnail URL of the audio or video file

CreationTime.description_en: The creation time of the audio or video file. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
CreationTime.description_zh: 音/视频创建时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

Description.description_en: The description of the audio or video file

Duration.description_en: The duration of the audio or video file. Unit: seconds

ModificationTime.description_en: The last modification time of the video. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)

ReferenceId.description_en: The custom ID. Only lowercase letters, uppercase letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores are supported. The value must be 6 to 64 characters in length and is unique at the user level
ReferenceId.description_zh: 自定义ID，仅支持小写字母、大写字母、数字、横线、下划线，长度 6-64 位。用户维度唯一
ReferenceId.title_zh: 自定义ID，仅支持小写字母、大写字母、数字、横线、下划线，长度 6-64 位。用户维度唯一。

RestoreExpiration.description_en: The expiration time of the media asset restoration

RestoreStatus.description_en:
The restoration status of the media asset. Valid values:
Processing: The media asset is being restored.
Success: The media asset has been restored.
Failed: The media asset failed to be restored
RestoreStatus.description_zh:
媒资解冻状态。取值：
Processing：解冻中。
Success：解冻成功。
Failed：解冻失败

Size.description_en: The size of the source audio or video file. Unit: bytes
Size.description_zh: 音/视频源文件大小。单位：字节

Snapshot.description_en: The array of video snapshot URLs

items.description_en:
The video snapshot URL.

Snapshot data is returned only for videos that have been processed by [video snapshots]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/99368.html）. Otherwise, an empty value is returned
items.description_zh:
视频截图URL。

只有经过[视频截图]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/99368.html）处理的视频，才会返回截图数据，否则返回为空

Status.description_en:
The video status. Valid values:

Uploading: The video is being uploaded.
UploadFail: The video failed to be uploaded.
UploadSucc: The video has been uploaded.
Transcoding: The video is being transcoded.
TranscodeFail: The video failed to be transcoded.
Checking: The video is being reviewed.
Blocked: The video is blocked.
Normal: The video is in a normal state.
ProduceFail: The video failed to be produced.

For more information about video statuses and related limits, see [Status: video status](~~52839#section-p7c-jgy-070~~)
Status.description_zh:
视频状态。取值：

Uploading：上传中。

UploadSucc：上传完成。
Transcoding：转码中。
TranscodeFail：转码失败。
Checking：审核中。

各视频状态的具体含义解释及相关限制，请参见[Status：视频状态](~~52839#section-p7c-jgy-070~~)

StorageClass.description_en:
The storage class of the media asset. Valid values:

Standard: standard.
IA: Infrequent Access for media assets.
Archive: Archive for media assets.
ColdArchive: Cold Archive for media assets.
SourceIA: Infrequent Access for source files.
SourceArchive: Archive for source files.
SourceColdArchive: Cold Archive for source files.
Changing: The storage class of the media asset is being changed.
SourceChanging: The storage class of the source file is being changed
StorageClass.description_zh:
媒资存储类型。取值：

Standard：标准。
IA：媒资低频。
Archive：媒资归档。
ColdArchive：媒资冷归档。
SourceIA：源文件低频。
SourceArchive：源文件归档。
SourceColdArchive：源文件冷归档。
Changing：媒资存储类型变更中。
SourceChanging：源文件存储类型变更中

StorageLocation.description_en: The storage address of the audio or video file

Tags.description_en: The tags of the audio or video file. Multiple tags are separated by commas (,)
Tags.description_zh: 音/视频标签。多个用半角逗号（,）分隔

Title.description_en: The title of the audio or video file

UserData.description_en: The custom settings. The value is a JSON string that supports settings such as message callbacks and upload acceleration. For more information, see [UserData]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86952.html）
UserData.description_zh: 自定义设置。为 JSON 字符串，支持消息回调、上传加速等设置。更多信息，请参见 [UserData]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86952.html）
